maddeler.e:
اقتحما (form VIII)
# اِقْتَحَمَا (iqtaḥamā) /iq.ta.ħa.maː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# اُقْتُحِمَا (uqtuḥimā) /uq.tu.ħi.maː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# اِقْتَحِمَا (iqtaḥimā) /iq.ta.ħi.maː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
